How it works

Working Principle of Collar Type Packing Machine

Film Roll Feeding

Laminated packaging film roll is mounted onto film unwinding section

Collar Forming Process

Film passes through specially designed forming collar

➜ Collar mechanism converts flat laminate film into tubular pouch shape automatically.

Product Filling Operation

Machine handles: ✔ Pan masala ✔ Tobacco ✔ Spices ✔ Namkeen ✔ Pulses ✔ Granules ✔ Powders accurately and continuously.

Vertical Sealing & Pouch Formation

Vertical sealing system creates: Center seal pouches Pillow pouches Gusset pouches with consistent sealing quality.

Horizontal Sealing & Cutting

Horizontal sealing jaws: Seal pouch top and bottom Cut finished packets automatically

Finished Pouch Discharge

Finished pouches discharged automatically for: Collection Cartoning Secondary packaging Dispatch operations
